jobs.title: Lead Technical Recruiter
jobs.description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role As Lead Technical Recruiter, you will lead critical technical searches, raise recruiting quality across the team and help build Act's technical recruiting capability. What You Will Be Doing Lead Act's highest-priority technical searches across AI/ML, engineering leadership, backend, infrastructure, web and mobile. Build search strategies and talent maps for scarce technical talent across global AI and engineering markets. Personally source, engage, assess and close senior and difficult-to-hire candidates. Set a high bar for technical profile assessment, ensuring recruiters understand candidates' actual work, technical depth and relevance before progressing them. Partner closely with engineering leadership to define hiring profiles, calibrate interview standards and diagnose gaps in the recruiting funnel. Coach technical recruiters on sourcing strategy, profile assessment, candidate engagement and closing. Review pipeline quality and recruiting data, identify where searches are failing and change strategy quickly. Develop repeatable recruiting practices that improve hiring quality and speed as Act scales.
